issues.issue: Should the new evidence (identity card, family photo, voter registration, news articles) be admitted on appeal?
issues.applicant_position: Submitted new evidence including an identity card, family photo, voter registration and news articles on Khalistan and Covid-19.
issues.result_text: Appeal granted without considering the new evidence, since referral back to the RPD makes it unnecessary.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err in its credibility assessment, including by relying on lack of documentary corroboration?
issues.applicant_position: RPD wrongly impugned credibility for lack of corroboration and wrongly found letters and an affidavit fraudulent.
issues.result_text: RPD impugned credibility for lack of corroboration without first having reason to question her credibility.

issues.issue: Did the RPD fail to consider the sur place claim?
issues.applicant_position: Her activities at the Brampton Gurudwara came to the attention of Indian authorities.
issues.result_text: RPD did not address the sur place claim it had allowed the appellant to document; this is an error.

issues.issue: Was the RPD's internal flight alternative finding in Mumbai reasonable?
issues.result_text: IFA viability cannot be assessed without first assessing the sur place claim; matter referred back to the RPD.
